title: W-11 and W-12: restore mints a key without the setup lock; a crash during setup can lose the pinned vault id
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-11 (low), W-12 (low). acquireSetupSession has one call site, so concurrent setup and restore each create a keychain item and one orphans; no confidentiality is lost. The setup journal is rewritten with O_TRUNC, so a crash between truncation and the durable replacement loses the pinned vault id. Files: src/cli/main.ts, src/application/backup.ts, src/adapters/setup-session.ts, ADR 0001 and 0006.

acceptanceCriteria.text: restore holds the setup session, or ADR 0006 records that it runs unserialised
The setup journal is replaced atomically: write, fsync, rename, fsync directory
